Kaisei Opti Notice
Repository Notice Scope: Supplemental third-party notice
Related Root Notice Version: 1.0.2
Material: Kaisei Opti font files
License: SIL Open Font License 1.1

This notice records the repository-specific use of Kaisei Opti font
material in Ludoxel. It supplements the upstream license text stored at
third-party/kaisei-opti/LICENSE.txt. It does not replace, translate as
controlling text, narrow, expand, or otherwise modify that license text.

The following files are treated as Kaisei Opti font material:

* assets/fonts/KaiseiOpti-Bold.ttf
* assets/fonts/KaiseiOpti-Medium.ttf
* assets/fonts/KaiseiOpti-Regular.ttf

Kaisei Opti is not Ludoxel Original Material. The Ludoxel Independent
License does not relicense Kaisei Opti, and the SIL Open Font License
1.1 does not relicense Ludoxel Original Materials.

When Ludoxel is distributed under authorization, the distribution
process must preserve the applicable Kaisei Opti license text and this
repository notice in a reasonably accessible location. The required
notice path in the source repository is:

* third-party/kaisei-opti/LICENSE.txt
* third-party/kaisei-opti/NOTICE.txt

If the Kaisei Opti font files are modified, subset, renamed, converted,
embedded, or otherwise transformed, the person performing that action
must confirm and follow the SIL Open Font License 1.1 requirements,
including any reserved-name and notice obligations that apply to the
specific transformation.

This notice does not state that any other font file in assets/fonts/ is
Kaisei Opti, open source, public domain, or freely redistributable.
Other font files must be assessed under their own provenance and
license records.

This notice does not grant permission to distribute Ludoxel. Ludoxel
distribution is governed by the root LICENSE and requires permission
under that license or a separate written agreement signed by Kento
Konishi.

This notice does not create an independent version sequence for the
Ludoxel Independent License, the root NOTICE, or the SIL Open Font
License. If the root NOTICE is amended before its current version is
committed, this supplemental notice must remain aligned with that root
NOTICE version and must not record a later version number.
